prompt: Write a recorded statement transcript (about 250 words) between an insurance adjuster (lines start with 'Q:') and the claimant (lines start with 'A:'). The claimant was the driver in a parking lot collision in Pasadena, Texas, and has knee injury. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1165; do not mention it.)
text:
Q: Thank you for taking the time to give this recorded statement. Please state your full name for the record.

A: I'd rather not put my full name on it yet, if that's okay. You can just call me the claimant.

Q: That's fine. Can you tell me where you were when the collision happened?

A: I was in a parking lot in Pasadena, Texas, at a shopping center. I was backing out of a space near the entrance.

Q: What happened as you were backing out?

A: I checked my mirror and it looked clear, so I started reversing slowly. Then I felt a bump on the driver's side and heard a loud scrape. The other vehicle was coming down the aisle pretty quickly and didn't stop.

Q: Were you moving fast at all?

A: No, I was barely moving, maybe walking speed. My foot was on the brake when it hit.

Q: Did you see the other driver before impact?

A: Not until right before. I saw a flash of silver out of the corner of my eye, but I didn't have time to react.

Q: Did you have any injuries from the collision?

A: Yes, my left knee hit the steering column and the dashboard area when I braced myself. It's swollen and I have trouble bending it. I've been icing it and taking it easy.

Q: Have you seen a doctor or received any treatment?

A: I went to an urgent care clinic the same day. They took X-rays and told me to follow up with an orthopedist if it doesn't improve.

Q: Is there anything else you think we should know about the incident?

A: Only that there were two witnesses standing near the cart return who saw the other car come through the lane. I can get their contact information for you.

Q: Thank you. We'll follow up with you on that. This concludes the statement.

A: Okay, thank you.
